targets.queryText: SELECT type, tokens FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'fresh input' AS type, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'cache write', coalesce(sum(cache_creation_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'cache read', coalesce(sum(cache_read_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'output', coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote})) ORDER BY ord
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT type, tokens FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'fresh input' AS type, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'cache write', coalesce(sum(cache_creation_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'cache read', coalesce(sum(cache_read_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'output', coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) FROM runs WHERE task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote})) ORDER BY ord

targets.queryText: SELECT task_id || ' / ' || config_id AS setup, avg(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM runs WHERE cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY task_id, config_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT task_id || ' / ' || config_id AS setup, avg(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds FROM runs WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY task_id, config_id ORDER BY seconds DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT tool, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tool, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY action ORDER BY calls DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY action ORDER BY calls DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, judge_runs.score, judge_runs.success, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, judge_runs.score, judge_runs.success, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Changed files
panels.description: Paths that differ from the task commit. branch is the git branch in the Chromium checkout, and it is the same as the run id.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.branch, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", json_extract(file.value, '$.status') AS status, json_extract(file.value, '$.path') AS path, json_extract(file.value, '$.previousPath') AS previous_path, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.started_at FROM runs, json_each(runs.changed_files) AS file WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, path LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.branch, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", json_extract(file.value, '$.status') AS status, json_extract(file.value, '$.path') AS path, json_extract(file.value, '$.previousPath') AS previous_path, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.started_at FROM runs, json_each(runs.changed_files) AS file WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, path LIMIT 500

targets.queryText: SELECT tool_calls.ts, tool_calls.run_id, tool, CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, substr(command, 1, 160) AS command, is_error FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY tool_calls.id DESC LIMIT 100
